arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import json

# Data from fiscal years 1960-1967 for matured noninterest-bearing debt (in millions)
data = {
    1960: 280,
    1961: 240,
    1962: 211,
    1963: 157,
    1964: 139,
    1965: 110,
    1966: 95,
    1967: 88
}

alpha = 0.4

# Single exponential smoothing
# S_0 = X_0 (first observation)
smoothed = {}
years = sorted(data.keys())

# Initialize with first value
smoothed[years[0]] = data[years[0]]
print(f"Year {years[0]}: X={data[years[0]]}, S={smoothed[years[0]]}")

# Calculate smoothed values for each subsequent year
for year in years[1:]:
    smoothed[year] = alpha * data[year] + (1 - alpha) * smoothed[year - 1]
    print(f"Year {year}: X={data[year]}, S={smoothed[year]}")

# The forecast for 1968 is the smoothed value from 1967
forecast_1968 = smoothed[1967]
print(f"\nForecast for 1968: {forecast_1968}")
print(f"Rounded to 2 decimal places: {round(forecast_1968, 2)}")
EOF
